verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships a built-in scheduler/automation system (cron jobs), webhook triggers that wake the agent from external events, Gmail PubSub triggers, and 'standing orders' granting permanent operating authority for autonomous programs — directly matching rule-based, event-triggered automation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the automation triggers working reliably in practice, and more detail on conditional/event-matching rule syntax beyond scheduling and webhooks.
